summary: Them bang correction_decision tien tinh TRUOC vong lap corrections (reviews duoc xu ly sau nen khong duoc tra nguoc approved_corrections - se phu thuoc thu tu lap), roi dung DUNG MOT quy tac thong nhat voi correction_chain_is_approved: mat xich truoc APPROVE thi noi vao current_sha256, mat xich truoc VO HIEU thi noi vao previous_sha256. Khong noi them hang rao nao: 5 test hang rao cu van xanh, cong 1 test moi cho dung ca nay (8/8).
assumptions: Da grep lai toan file de chac khong con cho thu tu nao mang cung gia dinh: chi con mot cho dung current_sha256 va do la phep so voi observed_sha256, khong lien quan chuoi supersede.
unresolved_risks: Day la lan thu hai sua bo may chong sua lich su trong mot phien. Can review doi khang muc tuong duong lan truoc.
